title: Why June Birthdays Are Great: What to Know About Your Gemini or Cancer Baby
content_body:
Expecting a June baby? Congratulations! Here are five fascinating facts about June birthdays.

Pregnant with a June baby? How lucky are you? Here's all the fun you can expect from having a baby born in June.

Key Takeaways

June babies have natural charm. They're born under the zodiac sign of Gemini — known for its quick-witted curiosity — or Cancer, famous for its big-hearted kindness.

June birthdays are VIPs. Your little one might be born on the same day as an Academy Award winner or a rock star.

Their star power is off the charts. You can have fun exploring your June baby's astrological traits with our free Birth Chart Calculator .

June's birthstone is a pearl, which symbolizes purity and innocence. In some cultures, pearls also represent a long life and prosperity.

Babies born in June are either Gemini (May 21 - June 20) or Cancer (June 21 - July 22). Geminis are smart and super curious. Cancers are nurturing and sensitive.

Your little star might share a birthday with Morgan Freeman ( June 1 ), Angelina Jolie ( June 4 ), Liam Neeson ( June 7 ), Neil Patrick Harris ( June 15 ), Paul McCartney ( June 18 ), Chris Pratt ( June 21 ), or Meryl Streep ( June 22 ).

Your June baby might be born on the first Friday in June , which is National Donut Day, or on June 15 — aka Smile Power Day. She could also be born on Father's Day (the third Sunday in June) or National Selfie Day ( June 21 ). If she arrives on June 3 , she'll blow out her candles each year on World Bicycle Day. Or, your June child might arrive close to a personal milestone. "My due date is 6/6 and my birthday is 6/12," shared What to Expect Community member h911. "It's kind of wild to think about possibly giving birth on or near my birthday. Talk about a gift!"
